item.title: Iran war lands 'triple blow' to flood-ravaged Sri Lankans
item.summary: The Iran war could not have come at a worse time for Sri Lanka, reeling from devastating floods and an economic crisis.

item.title: Concerns after satellite provider restricts Iran images following US pressure
item.summary: Planet Labs says it is restricting coverage of Iran and parts of the Middle East indefinitely.

item.title: 'We need real peace': Easter truce fails to lift grim mood in war-torn Ukraine
item.summary: Easter festivities are muted in Kharkiv as Ukrainians expect fighting to flare up again after a weekend truce.

item.title: At least 30 feared dead in crush at Haitian tourist site
item.summary: The incident occurred at a "tourist event attended by many young people", Haiti's prime minister says.

item.title: We spoke to the man making viral Lego-style AI videos for Iran. Experts say it's powerful propaganda
item.summary: "Slopaganda" is too weak a term to capture how powerful this "highly sophisticated" content is, one expert says.

item.title: Nearly 400 sentenced in Nigeria for links to militant Islamists
item.summary: Judges handed down sentences ranging from five years to life imprisonment following mass trials.

item.title: Hungarians vote on whether to end 16 years of Orbán rule and elect rival
item.summary: Most polls favour Péter Magyar, who fronts a grassroots party, and early figures suggest a big turnout of voters.

item.title: Why this disillusioned Trump voter spends hours searching Epstein files
item.summary: Many who support the president have expressed frustration with how Trump's former attorney general Pam Bondi handled the Epstein files.

item.title: Irish cabinet meeting to be held to discuss ongoing fuel protests
item.summary: Hundreds of petrol stations in the Republic of Ireland have run out of fuel as the protests and blockades continued for a fifth day.

item.title: Djibouti's president wins unprecedented sixth term with 97.8% of vote
item.summary: Ismail Omar Guelleh, 78, has extended his already 27-year rule in a poll boycotted by the main opposition candidates.
